subject: Clearhaven private deployment — sprint orchestration & network review
messages:
From: Alex Torres <atorres@clearhaven.io>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Clearhaven private deployment — initial network constraints

Hi Soojin / Priyom (cc Ben),

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from my side so we can get the onboarding sprint started:

- Goal: pilot Redwood Private in our staging environment, then migrate a single production service to the private on-prem package by Aug 1.
- Cloud footprint: primary AWS account (acct: 578392104) in us-west-2; we will also run a small on-prem appliance in our data center in Portland.
- Networking asks: VPC peering between our account and Redwood's peering VPC; private endpoints for model inference traffic; advice on routing for kv-cache replication.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 artifacts are ready for review; we require KMS integration and audit log retention settings to be documented.

I've attached an inventory spreadsheet with account IDs, CIDR ranges, and contact points (attachment: clearhaven-infra-inventory.xlsx).

Can you confirm next steps and a proposed date for a 1-hour network deep-dive with your infra team? We'd like that by next week if possible.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Torres
Director of Platform Engineering
Clearhaven Health
atorres@clearhaven.io

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@clearhaven.io>, Priya Anand <priya@clearhaven.io>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Clearhaven private deployment — initial network constraints

Alex — thanks for the clear inventory. This is exactly what we need to start planning. High-level proposal / immediate next steps: 

1) Schedule a network deep-dive (1h) with our infra engineers — proposed slots Wed 2026-06-23 10:00 or Thu 2026-06-24 14:00 PT. Please let me know what works.
2) We will produce a draft VPC peering diagram and private endpoint plan ahead of the meeting (attachment: networking-diagram-v1.pdf).
3) Internal owners: Ben will lead the connectivity/peering design; Laura (CS delivery) will own the on-prem packaging checklist and validation runbook.
4) Commercial handoff: Priyom, please confirm contractual items and MAP so we can align timelines.

I've attached our standard Redwood Private on-prem checklist for your review (redwood-private-onprem-checklist.pdf). Two quick clarifications before the call: what KMS provider (AWS KMS vs. HSM) will you prefer for key management, and do you have an approved IP range for peering that can't be changed?

If this looks good, I'll lock in the meeting and share a calendar invite with a Join link + pre-read.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: quick tech notes on peering and on-prem

Team — internal notes before the deep-dive: 

- Peering model: prefer route-based VPC peering with explicit prefixes for the inference subnets (we should avoid full-range peering to limit blast radius).
- Private endpoints: we'll propose an endpoint in the customer's VPC that forwards to our NAT egress in us-west-2; discuss whether a proxy appliance in their Portland DC is required for KV cache replication.
- KMS: if they want AWS KMS we can integrate with cross-account key policies; if they insist on HSM we'd need additional hardware certs — flagging as a potential 2-week delay.
- Firewall rules: ask Clearhaven to open outbound port 443 to our egress IPs and allow inbound TLS from our peered subnets for model telemetry.

I'll draft a one-pager for the call. Laura — can you prepare the on-prem appliance acceptance checklist (image + smoke-test steps) so we can attach to the MAP?

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
